description: This Java source file contains integration tests for custom snapshot event generation within the Fineract project. It defines multiple test cases to verify behavior related to external event creation when loan installments are unpaid, paid, or when certain configurations are disabled. It extends a base test class and uses various helper classes and annotations to set up, execute, and validate tests related to loan account snapshots and COB (Close of Business) processes.

classes.name: CustomSnapshotEventIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the generation and suppression of custom snapshot external events during loan processing scenarios, especially in relation to COB (Close of Business) operations, using various configurations and payment states.

methods.name: testSnapshotEventGenerationWhenLoanInstallmentIsNotPayed
methods.description: Tests that a custom snapshot event is generated when a loan installment is overdue and unpaid, verifying the payload contents.

methods.name: testNoSnapshotEventGenerationWhenLoanInstallmentIsPayed
methods.description: Ensures no custom snapshot event is generated if the overdue installment has been paid.

methods.name: testNoSnapshotEventGenerationWhenWhenCustomSnapshotEventCOBTaskIsNotActive
methods.description: Validates that no event is triggered when the COB task related to custom snapshots is inactive.

methods.name: testNoSnapshotEventGenerationWhenCOBDateIsNotMatchingWithInstallmentDueDate
methods.description: Checks that no event is generated when the COB date does not match the installment due date.

methods.name: testNoSnapshotEventGenerationWhenCustomSnapshotEventIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that disabling the custom snapshot event configuration prevents event generation.

methods.name: enableCOBBusinessStep
methods.description: Helper method to enable specific COB business steps in the test environment.

methods.name: getExternalEventConfigurationsForUpdateJSON
methods.description: Produces a JSON string to update external event configurations, specifically enabling certain external events.

methods.name: updateBusinessDateAndExecuteCOBJob
methods.description: Updates the business date and triggers the COB job execution for test scenarios.
